count_only: KUTTA_PROFILE_COUNTS_ONLY=1 retains native batching; counts nonempty sync calls and backpressure waits; wait_s is host steady_clock time in buffer waits.
method: Scratch family-boundary command-buffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime. Native count-only mode is separate. Probes active after warmup, disabled before final wall export; no instrumentation retained in source.
